name: CAMF_MANUAL
meaning: player turned the camera (look / mode 5); cleared by SetMode. Wolf_UpdateCamera turns Ralph to the camera yaw when set and dist < 0x15

name: CAMF_SMOOTH
meaning: smoothing active; SetMode's second argument; when clear Camera_SmoothToDesired snaps once

name: CAMF_SNAP
meaning: set by Camera_Reset; cleared at the end of each Camera_Update; forces snap and disables collision in several modes

name: CAMF_TOOFAR_CUT
meaning: TOO-FAR cut requested this frame (cleared when the sweep has no contact)
